acceptance: If anonymizing: a raw local DuckDB TPC-H SF1 run passes `benchbox submit` with a test salt and the packaged bundle passes validate_submission.py --require-manifest; tests cover path and tuning redaction through submit.
If docs-only: docs describe the real behaviour and point contributors to the working path.
description:
Found while fixing local bundle validation (#3483, history://BundleValidation). docs/contributing-results.md says `benchbox submit` pseudonymizes the bundle, but benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py only checks that a salt is set and then validates and packages the raw bytes. A raw local run therefore can never pass submission validation through the community path (absolute paths, harness tuning diagnostics). The maintainer path is scripts/stage_seed_corpus_bundle.py --internal-manifest.
DECISION GATE: (G1) make submit anonymize before validating (recommended: same anonymiser as stage_seed_corpus_bundle.py, salt from the documented variable), or correct the docs to the actual behaviour. Owner decides.
GUARDRAILS: never relax validate_submission checks; never commit a salt; external submissions keep the official-only compliance rule.
